Team — quick internal note so we're aligned before the committee result:

Context: Stellarmark wants a product-first pilot (embeddings + reranking). CapEx committee on 26 Apr may force a spend cap/smaller scope or push decision into May. Exec travel limits demo attendance to week of May 10+.

Recommended approach:
- Hold May 11, 10–11 PT tentatively (do not publish calendar invites with firm acceptance).
- Prepare a scoped "Phase 0" pilot priced at $22k covering a 2-week run + integration checklist (this stays under the $30k threshold). Include a deferred invoice clause that turns into normal billing once committee approves any expansion.
- Tessa: prepare a 30–40 minute product demo focusing on embeddings quality and a short reranking case study. Include a 10-min ops/latency section showing expected QPS/latency on their query mix.
- Rishi: draft a short commercial term addendum (deferred billing + cancellation window) and a simple SOW for Phase 0. I will review before we send to Liam.

If the committee defers to May, we'll propose the Phase 0 timeline starting immediately after approval and switch demo to an async recorded session if execs can't attend.

Thanks — Priyom

Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
